geometryMethod: Continuous shaped torso, sleeves, trouser legs, boots, digits and canine trunk/tail. Smooth multi-joint weights across joint collars, explicit human spine/digits and canine hocks; UV seams retain averaged normals. Armor/equipment stay rigid. Material batches and immutable geometry shared across instances; bones and deforming cape independent. All material batches within an actor share one skeleton palette; each actor has independent cloned bones.

animationRecipe.origin: Original analytic poses and visual-only contact/transition logic. No motion capture imported.

qualityBoundary: Original analytic modelling, not photogrammetry, scan-derived anatomy or imported mocap. CPU topology/weight/contact checks do not establish WebGL appearance, device FPS or PS4/flagship parity.
